note: The device registry of the Cerid CI platform (ADR-0135, docs/design/ci-platform.md): one entry per device cell. ci/pipeline.py schedules only cells whose status is active and whose accounts exist; every other cell is shown by the dashboard as waiting, never as pass. Prices are spot or list estimates for the budget ledger only; the GCP budget is the authority on real spend. Add a cell with `python ci/ops.py add-device`.

budget.price_basis: Google Cloud list and spot prices, us-central1, read 2026-10-30; disks prorated per hour; the Windows Server licence is billed per second at 0.046 USD per vCPU hour and is not discounted on spot
